basic_info.description: Rare North Beach Duplex Opportunity.   1554–1556 Powell Street, San Francisco.  Located in the heart of San Francisco's iconic North Beach neighborhood, this rare duplex offers a truly unique opportunity. Each unit features 2 bedrooms, 1.5 bathrooms, a living and dining area, and a kitchen equipped with a gas stove and dishwasher. A washer and dryer are conveniently located just outside the kitchen door, along with additional storage space. The upper unit at 1556 Powell includes a designated living room, adding to its charm and functionality.  This property also boasts an approx. 1,000 sq. ft. basement, providing endless possibilities for expansion, a creative studio, or storage. With a little imagination, the rooftop could be transformed into a spectacular outdoor retreat—perfect for hosting BBQs, gardening, or enjoying front-row views of the Blue Angels during Fleet Week.  Just steps from world-class restaurants, boutique shops, Chinatown, and Washington Square Park, you’ll be immersed in one of San Francisco’s most vibrant and walkable communities. Don’t miss your chance to own a piece of San Francisco in one of its most sought-after locations!  Property is virtually staged.
